description: This file defines the 'DefinedNames' class responsible for managing and writing named ranges and other defined names in an Excel XLSX spreadsheet, including handling auto filters, print titles, and print areas during the export process.

classes.name: DefinedNames
classes.description: A class to handle the writing of defined names, including named ranges, auto filters, print titles, and print areas, within an XLSX spreadsheet during export.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object with an XMLWriter instance and a Spreadsheet instance.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Main method that writes all defined names, named ranges, auto filters, print titles, and print areas to the XML writer.

methods.name: writeNamedRangesAndFormulae
methods.description: Writes all named ranges defined in the spreadsheet.

methods.name: writeDefinedName
methods.description: Writes a single defined name element for a named range, handling scope and formatting.

methods.name: writeNamedRangeForAutofilter
methods.description: Writes a named range for the auto filter range of a worksheet, if set.

methods.name: writeNamedRangeForPrintTitles
methods.description: Writes a named range for print titles (rows and columns) if set.

methods.name: writeNamedRangeForPrintArea
methods.description: Writes a named range for the print area of a worksheet if set.

methods.name: getDefinedRange
methods.description: Returns the correct cell reference range string for a given DefinedName, converting relative references to absolute references.
